description: Read-only ledger access. Program design section 2: no command in this contract accepts a write path, a delete path, or a ledger-mutating argument; this capability grants only core defaults plus the custom read-only IPC commands in `src/commands.rs`. There is no `fs` plugin dependency: file reads happen inside those Rust commands (std::fs, not a JS-facing fs plugin), so no `fs:*` permission is declared or needed.
